purpose: Additive typed carrier for scientific assertion semantics that are not losslessly represented by ClaimIR-v1 relation arguments or by L_sys Grammar-v0 relations.

scope_boundary.calibration_set: the 14 PVS-16 relations classified PARTIAL or UNMAPPED by the already-frozen prospective Grammar-v0 mapping
scope_boundary.note: This schema is designed after observing the PVS layered-recovery cases. Closure on those cases is calibration, not independent validation.

carrier_fields.source_arguments: exact ordered frozen ClaimIR relation arguments; never rewritten by the carrier
carrier_fields.qualifiers: zero or more orthogonal assertion qualifiers
carrier_fields.argument_bindings: typed semantic roles for source_arguments with architecture-layer bindings
carrier_fields.semantic_references: additional semantically required ClaimIR node references not present in source_arguments
carrier_fields.support_provenance: assertion-level provenance such as experimentally manipulated/supported, separate from P_in unless a frozen intervention node exists
carrier_fields.assertion_scope_qualifiers: claim-scope qualifiers needed for the assertion but not represented as ClaimIR nodes

invariants: source_arguments must byte-semantically reproduce the frozen relation argument list in order
source_kind must equal the frozen relation kind
every argument binding must reference exactly one source_argument
every semantic_reference must reference an existing ClaimIR node that is not already in source_arguments
semantic_references may add assertion-level participation but never mutate the frozen structural graph
L_ctx references require a placement from the already-frozen context vocabulary
assertion predicates and qualifiers remain L_claim semantics and are never promoted to K solely to improve coverage
support provenance does not create P_in when frozen ClaimIR lacks an intervention node
source-level neural implementation claims are not L_formal
carrier FULL means the assertion can be stated using the existing predicate/qualifier/reference vocabulary; it does not imply truth, evidence strength, or formal-logical completeness
migration_note: A future ClaimIR v2 could internalize selected carrier fields, but this v1 artifact is deliberately external and additive.
